senses.gloss:
झर झर, अस्, आ or ई, m. f. a cascade, a
water-fall; (ई), f. a river; [cf. निर्-झर.]

झरत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, flowing or falling down;
[cf. क्षर्.]

झर्च् झर्च्, cl. 6. P. झर्चति, or झर्छ्,
cl. 6. P. झर्छति, or झर्झ्, cl. 6. P.
झर्झति, to speak; to blame, menace; injure.

झर्झर झर्झर, अस्, ई, m. f. (said to be fr.
[]
the last), a sort of drum; (अस्), m. the Kali-yuga,
the present Yuga or age of the world; N. of a
Daitya, a son of Hiraṇyākṣa; N. of a river; (आ),
f. a whore [cf. ऋच्छरा]; (अम्), n. a sound as of
splashing or dropping.

झार्झर झार्झर or झार्झरिक, अस्, m. (fr.
झर्झर), a tabor-player, a drummer.

झर्झरक, अस्, m. the fourth or present age of
the world, the Kali-yuga.

झर्झरिन्, ई, इणी, इ, furnished with a drum; epi-
thet of Śiva.

झर्झरीक झर्झरीक, अस्, m. the body; a
region, a country; a picture.
